payload.reason: The evidence indicates that the layer norm approximation negatively impacts performance when not optimized individually, particularly in the context of the tasks discussed.

claims.text: Jointly finetuning the softmax estimation model and approximated layernorm leads to a performance drop across all tasks, with significant drops observed in specific tasks like STS-B.
Using a 'Negative Infinity' mask value greatly reduces approximation performance, suggesting that the choice of mask values is critical for maintaining performance.
Fine-tuning different components individually may yield better performance, indicating that the layer norm approximation requires careful optimization.
